prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: FireSlop furniture modeling concept sheet, draft. Style: match existing chunky low-poly cartoon furniture: simple beveled box construction, matte flat colors, warm honey wood and brown structural parts, bold clean dark outline, minimal broad shading, white background. Landscape sheet with one large three-quarter view at top and smaller front, right side and top orthographic construction views below. Keep the identical design, part counts and proportions across all views. Objects fully visible, generous separation. Short English title and view labels only. No decorative room props, people, brands, textures, dimension arrows or clutter. These are simple affordable apartment furnishings, economical to model for a Unity WebGL game. COAT RACK. A freestanding compact wooden coat tree with one thick brown central square post, exactly four sturdy short upward angled hooks at the top arranged in cross directions, and four broad low feet extending in a cross at the base. Rounded beveled ends, honey wood hooks, brown post and base. Empty rack: no coats, hats, shoes or accessories. Make the four-hook/four-foot construction understandable across views.
reference_usage: Existing coffee-table sheet inspected for chunky bevels, warm honey wood and brown legs; prompt-based style guidance.
